segments.speaker: Thông báo
segments.text: This is a message from the information technology team. Our S A P training system will be unavailable this Saturday from eight in the morning until noon while we install a software update. The production system will remain available, so regular business activities can continue. Please save your practice work and log out of the training system by seven forty-five. When the update is complete, we will send a confirmation email. If you need help signing in afterward, contact the help desk rather than creating a new account.
